name: Ayonga Hereid
title: Associate Professor; Principal Investigator, Cyberbotics Lab
fitReason: Strong learning-and-control fit: hierarchical RL, reduced-order representations and model-based execution for legged robots. Concrete learned physical control is established, although the strongest verified deployment here predates the newest simulated perception methods.

physicalEvidence.summary: The 2023 study revised January 2024 and accepted at ICRA2024 physically tests Digit using a pneumatic impactor. Its task-space-learning controller combines an RL high-level planner with TSID low-level tracking; it is compared with classical and manufacturer controllers. Ohio State Cyberbotics and biomechanics facilities are credited. The December 2025 terrain-aware CNN-VAE/RL paper adds real depth-sensor comparisons, but locomotion evaluation remains simulated. June 2025 SAC subgoal navigation also explicitly leaves hardware deployment to future work. January 2026 university reporting supports continuing local humanoid research, without proving those newer learned pipelines ran physically.

shortVisit.summary: Official current directory lists Associate Professor and public email. The lab identifies Hereid as PI and names graduate advisees, but no current external master’s short-visitor invitation was verified.

scoreReasons.fit: Direct hierarchical RL and learned representation methods for legged physical control.
scoreReasons.physical: Real local Digit learned-policy testing is clear, but dated 2023–24; newer perceptive RL motion is not physically verified.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No current external short-visitor pathway found.
scoreReasons.freshness: Current directory and April 2026 official robotic-autonomy award activity; latest concrete learned hardware remains older.
